FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/jasonxtn/Argus /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -lc 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc g++ libffi-dev libssl-dev libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev zlib1g-dev' && JAYINT_APT_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=$?; (apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; if [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install --upgrade pip' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install -r requirements.txt' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install setuptools wheel build' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install "cmd2<4" "rich>=13,<14" "mmh3>=4,<5" "lxml>=5,<6" "packaging>=24,<25" "paramiko>=3,<4"' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"

eval_script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /testbed


cd /testbed

set +e
(
pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
)
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e

echo "echo OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE"
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE

build_commands: apt-get install -y gcc g++ libffi-dev libssl-dev libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev zlib1g-dev

excluded_commands.command: apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc g++ libffi-dev libssl-dev libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev zlib1g-dev git curl wget nmap whois dnsutils net-tools iputils-ping traceroute && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
excluded_commands.reason: compound command rejected before execution; also included unnecessary runtime tools not required for setup
failed action (step 10) - setuptools not yet installed; retried successfully later
read-only directory listing, no persistent effect

build_recipe.rationale: The build commands replicate the exact successful persistent state-changing steps from the setup trajectory. The sequence begins with system dependency installation (apt-get update + apt-get install), followed by pip upgrade, then installation of Python dependencies from requirements.txt, build tools (setuptools, wheel, build), editable installation of the project, and finally pinning specific dependency versions to resolve compatibility (downgrading cmd2, etc.). Read-only inspections, the rejected compound command, and a failed attempt at editable install are excluded. The test command is placed in test_commands as per the verification bundle.
